title: Umphefumlo Ongasemva Kwesithixo
intro: Emthunzini wokuphuma okukhulu kubuzwilakhe, lo mntu ungaqondakaliyo wayelinde entlango. Ngelixa inkokheli yabantu abakhethiweyo yayinyuka intaba engcwele ukuze ifumane umthendeleko kaThixo, ityala elikhulu lehla phezu kwabo bashiyekileyo. Lo mntu wathabatha eli thuba ukuze atshintshe iinkolelo zoluntu lonke. Xa inkokheli yabuya nenyaniso, kwamiselwa isohlwayo esikhethekileyo nesingunaphakade. Ungachaza ukuba ngubani lo mphefumlo uphikisanayo nonobuqhetseba?
clues: Ndahamba nabantu ababekhululwe ezandleni zomcinezeli onamandla ngemiqondiso emangalisayo.
Xa inkokeli yabo yaya entabeni ukuze ifumane ulwalathiso, ndalinda phakathi kwabo baseleyo.
Ndaqokelela isinyithi esixabisekileyo kwizihombiso zabo ndaza ndasenza into evelisa isandi.
Ngale ndalo, ndaqinisekisa isizukulwana sonke ukuba simfumene uthixo waso entlango.
Xa inkokheli ibuya, ndakhethwa ndaza ndabuzwa ukuba yintoni eyandikhokelela ekukhohliseni okunjalo.
Isohlwayo sam kweli hlabathi yayikukuba akukho mntu undichukumisayo okanye osondelayo, uphawu lwehlazo endiluthwele ngonaphakade.

arabic: قَالَ فَٱذْهَبْ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّن تُخْلَفَهُۥ ۖ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِى ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًۭا ۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ نَسْفًا
verse: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it [i.e., its ashes] into the sea with a blast. (20:97)
